problem_statement: This is the Famms static fashion storefront: a multi-page shop with a Home page, a Products page, an About page, a Blog and a Contact page, all sharing one navbar (logo, Home / Pages / Products / Blog / Contact links and a shopping-bag icon) and one footer. The 'Our products' grid on the Home and Products pages lists twelve garments (Men's Shirts and Women's Dresses, $58-$80) whose imagery is served from the local /images stock (p1..p12.png), and there is also a full Catalog page. The owner wants a genuine 'Collection finder' for the storefront: a filter bar sitting directly above the product grid with All / Men / Women / Sale tabs and a live 'Showing N of 12' readout that filters the cards as you switch collection, plus a live bag badge next to the navbar shopping-bag icon that increments when a shopper adds an item. Ship the Collection finder so it (1) appears above the grid consistently on the shopping pages - Home, Products AND the Catalog page, not just the Home page, (2) lays out its tab row responsively without horizontal overflow on a phone and keeps the product cards from overlapping or clipping, (3) matches Famms's own quiet light styling with the red brand accent - a legible bar, not a washed-out illegible panel or a collapsed overlapping grid, and (4) keeps the readout and the header bag badge in sync so that clicking the 'Men' tab shows 'Showing 6 of 12 . Men' and clicking 'Add to bag' makes the badge read the live count of one. Keep the rest of the site - the navbar, the footer, the product listings and the local /images assets - intact with no console or network errors.
required_content: Add a shared 'Collection finder' filter bar directly above the product grid on the shopping pages - Home, Products AND the Catalog page - with identical bar markup, not only the Home page.
The bar shows All / Men / Women / Sale tabs and a live readout 'Showing N of 12 . <label>' that filters the product cards by collection as the shopper switches tabs.

The tab row must wrap responsively and the product grid must stay a tidy wrapping grid so no page overflows horizontally on a 390px phone (overflow tolerance 24px) and no cards overlap or get clipped off the viewport.
Style the bar in Famms's own quiet light language (white/near-white surface, light borders, dark legible text with the red brand accent), not a washed-out illegible panel.

Wire the readout and the header bag badge: clicking the 'Men' tab must update the readout to 'Showing 6 of 12 . Men', and clicking 'Add to bag' on the Home page must make the badge (class cart-count) read the live count '1' - both must re-read the live state, not rewrite a stale captured value.
Preserve the navbar, the footer, the product listings and the local /images assets with no console or network errors.
author_notes: Built on the themewagon Famms template (the Famms fashion storefront), a static multi-page commerce site whose Home, Products, About, Blog and Contact pages share one navbar and one footer and whose product art is served from the local /images stock folder (p1..p12.png). The Collection finder is a shared markup block placed directly above the 'Our products' grid on the shopping pages (Home, Products, Catalog); its All / Men / Women / Sale tabs filter the twelve local product cards and drive a live 'Showing N of 12' readout, grounding the finder in the storefront's own catalog. The header bag badge reuses the existing navbar shopping-bag icon as its anchor and is driven by a small shared collection-finder script's add-to-bag handler. The injected leostop tracking beacon in the vendored bootstrap bundle was neutralised and the owl-carousel and Google-Maps calls in the template script were guarded so the storefront runs offline with no console or network errors. The responsive wrapping tab row and grid, the light red-accent design integration and the filter/add-to-bag wiring were designed by hand for this Famms storefront, not bulk-generated.
design_constraints: Implement the Collection finder as one shared bar markup + stylesheet reused across the shopping pages so a single source of truth reaches Home, Products and Catalog; do not paste divergent copies or build a detached widget.

The tab row must use a fluid, wrapping responsive layout (no fixed-width nowrap track) and the product grid must remain a wrapping grid so it never forces horizontal overflow on tablet or mobile and never overlaps or clips the product cards.
The bar must adopt Famms's own light surface/border/text language and red brand accent so it reads as part of the storefront and its readout text stays legible, not a washed-out illegible panel.

The readout and the header bag badge must reflect the CURRENT state after every click by reading the live filter result and cart count, so they can never go stale relative to what the shopper selected or added.
Do not remove or regress the navbar, the footer, the product listings or the local /images assets.

change_completion: The Collection finder bar is present above the grid on Home, Products AND Catalog (the shared bar reaches all shopping pages, not just Home).

After clicking the 'Men' tab the readout reads 'Showing 6 of 12 . Men' and after clicking 'Add to bag' the header bag badge (cart-count) updates to '1' - the post-interaction terminal states changed from their initial values.
design_consistency: The bar on the in-viewport states matches the reference's quiet light styling under the visual-regression gate (pixel/ssim/block-fidelity), not a washed-out illegible panel or a collapsed overlapping grid.
The bar adopts Famms's own white surface, light border, dark text and red accent tokens so it reads as part of the storefront across the pages.
responsive: No captured page overflows horizontally beyond 24px on a 390px phone; the tab row and product grid wrap without overlapping or clipping cards.
mobile_initial, mobile_collfind_home and tablet_collfind_home keep the Collection finder readable across viewports without clipping or overflow.
regression: The navbar, the footer and the product listings remain present and functional across the pages.
The local /images assets and the static pages are not removed or broken, with no console or network errors.

state_constraints: desktop_initial, tablet_initial and mobile_initial protect the Famms home and responsive shell.
desktop_product and desktop_catalog protect the existing Products page and the Catalog page and carry the Collection finder.
desktop_collfind_home and mobile_collfind_home scroll the Collection finder into view and must show the legible light bar and a tidy grid without horizontal overflow or overlapping cards.
desktop_collfind_products and desktop_collfind_catalog protect the finder's presence on the Products and Catalog pages.
tablet_collfind_home protects the finder's tablet layout without overflow.
desktop_filter_men_home clicks the 'Men' tab; the readout must then read 'Showing 6 of 12 . Men'.
add_to_bag_home clicks the Add-to-bag button; the header bag badge must then read '1'.
